feature.description: Extract deterministic user data/config/cache path resolution for Linux, macOS, and Windows without importing platformdirs.
included_behaviors: Linux XDG_DATA_HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, and XDG_CACHE_HOME precedence
macOS Application Support and Caches defaults
Windows LocalAppData vs AppData roaming behavior
Windows appauthor, appauthor=False, version, and cache opinion semantics
feature.name: User/cache/config/data path resolver

entanglement.description: Platform path resolution depends on environment variables, OS-specific base directories, app author conventions, version suffixing, and cache opinion semantics.
signals: Linux and macOS honor XDG overrides before platform defaults.
Windows data/config paths depend on roaming, appauthor, appname, and version.
Windows cache path inserts Cache before version only when opinion=True.

output.import: from featurelifted import user_cache_dir, user_config_dir, user_data_dir
output.signature: user_data_dir(appname=None, appauthor=None, version=None, roaming=False, platform="linux", env=None, home=None) -> str
